## Introduction

In this course we covered the layers of a computer and the vocabulary of digital logic. This page includes practice problems on the layers of a computer, hardware components, and digital-logic terms.

## How To Use This Page

For each problem, use the **↻ New variant** button to generate a new problem of that type. Use the **Check** button to check your answer. Use the **Show answer** button to see the answer and an explanation.

[Review the lesson](../../lessons/03%20Introduction%20to%20Computer%20Architecture/index.qmd){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
